name: Top - Ocho Extracts Airplane Mode Long Sleeved Tee
description:
Stay grounded while flying high with the Ocho Extracts Airplane Mode Long Sleeved Tee. Designed with a bold back graphic of girl in 'Do Not Disturb', and signature OCHO detailing, this black cotton long sleeve delivers a clean streetwear look with everyday comfort. Finished with subtle front chest logo accent, this piece is built for laid-back fits and cooler nights.

Features:• Soft cotton construction• Black long sleeve design• Large Airplane Mode back screen print graphic• Left chest logo detail• Relaxed everyday fit
